# GigaInvestors

> What 83 widely followed investors own, updated every quarter from SEC 13F filings (via dataroma.com), drawn as treemaps with pencil-sketch portraits. Business quality and price checklists share the same company pages. No accounts, no tracking.

## When to use this site

Use GigaInvestors when a task needs any of these, for the tracked set of 83 investors (Buffett, Burry, Ackman, Tepper, Klarman, Li Lu, Pabrai and others):
- What an investor currently holds, position weights and dollar values, and what they bought, added, reduced or sold in the latest quarter (`/{CODE}`, e.g. `/BRK`).
- Which of these investors hold a given stock, how much, what share of their portfolio it is, since when, and whether they were buying or selling (`/s/{TICKER}`, e.g. `/s/NVDA`).
- Portfolio history back to 2006, quarter by quarter, including exited positions.

The 13F section does not cover real-time prices, short positions, non-US portfolio holdings, cash levels, fund performance, or investors outside the tracked list. The checklist also covers non-US listed companies. 13F data lags the quarter end by up to 45 days.

## How to read it programmatically

- The home page, every investor page, 13F stock pages, /about, /privacy and every quarterly letter return Markdown when requested with `Accept: text/markdown` at the same URL (canonical HTML otherwise). Markdown responses declare `Vary: Accept`; the HTML variant does not, so key any cache of your own on the Accept header. Other paths return a short markdown pointer.
- Home `/` lists all investors with portfolio value and position count, and links to each page.
- Investor page `/{CODE}` lists positions (ticker, company, % of portfolio, value, this quarter's move, number of tracked holders) and portfolio value by quarter.
- The Markdown representation of a 13F stock page `/s/{TICKER}` lists holders (investor, value, % of their portfolio, move) and total held by quarter with split-adjusted reported price.
- Investor codes are dataroma's manager codes (e.g. BRK, SAM, PI); the home page maps names to codes.
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml. Trust pages: /about, /privacy. Contact: hello@gigainvestors.com.

## Notes

- Values are quarter-end reported values; a "price" is value ÷ shares from the filings, split-adjusted.
- Buying uses neutral outlines; selling uses hatching, with dashed outlines for sold positions. Checklist quality pass and fair price use the verdict greens; red means a checklist failure.
- One investor (Norbert Lou) has no public photo; Makaira Partners (MP) is tracked but currently reports no 13F holdings, so its page shows an empty state.

## Buffett checklist and company pages
- /value: five quality tests and price; ?q=2018Q3 selects a historical calendar quarter.
- /s/<TICKER>: one company page for the checklist, price story and superinvestor holdings. US tickers have no exchange suffix (AAPL); non-US retain it (PLX.PA, 7203.JP).
- /<CODE>: investor holdings with checklist verdict marks.
- ?q=YYYYQn carries the selected quarter across investors, companies and /value.
- The former value.gigainvestors.com host permanently redirects here, preserving query strings.
